<section id="architecture-documentation">
<h1>Architecture Documentation</h1>

<section id="introduction-and-goals">
<h1>Introduction and Goals</h1>
<section id="current-canonical-storage-boundary">
<h2>Current canonical storage boundary</h2>
<p>The current canonical design uses the schema-3 Ledgercore project at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.toml</span></code> with Taskledger configuration at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/task/config.toml</span></code>. Taskledger mounts are separated into authoritative durable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">data</span></code>, checkout-local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">runtime</span></code>, diagnostic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">logs</span></code>, and rebuildable cache <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">indexes</span></code>. Canonical initialization never creates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> or root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code>; those names are legacy migration inputs only.</p>
<p>Taskledger operational state is resolved outside the application source repository by default. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.local.toml</span></code> is a machine-local override and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> is ignored as legacy residue. The legacy <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger</span></code> layout described in older sections remains compatibility and migration material, not the canonical storage design.</p>
<p>Taskledger is a task-first durable state layer for staged coding work. It provides a Python CLI and library that manages the full lifecycle of coding tasks: creation, planning, user approval, implementation, validation, and completion.</p>
<p>The system is designed for use by both human developers and automated coding agents. Its primary goals are:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Durable task state</strong>: Every task, plan, run, lock, todo, and validation check is persisted as a Markdown record with YAML front matter in the project Ledgercore data mount. State survives process restarts, context switches, and handoffs between actors.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Explicit lifecycle gates</strong>: Transitions between stages (draft -&gt; planning -&gt; plan_review -&gt; approved -&gt; implementing -&gt; implemented -&gt; validating -&gt; done) are enforced by policy decisions. User approval is required before implementation begins. Validation checks gate completion.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Fresh-context handoffs</strong>: Agents and humans can create, claim, and close handoff records that capture enough context (task state, plan, todos, questions, lock status) for a fresh process to continue work without reading the entire history.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Machine-readable output</strong>: Every CLI command supports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> for structured output with a stable envelope shape (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ok</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">command</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_type</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">warnings</span></code>) and deterministic exit codes.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Opaque cross-ledger references</strong>: Task-ledger task, plan, file, and link references remain opaque strings. Taskledger does not interpret ledgercore global refs, archledger IDs, or other external system identifiers.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The canonical workflow is:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>task -&gt; plan -&gt; approval -&gt; implement -&gt; validate -&gt; done
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>This workflow is the product contract, not decoration. Deviations from this flow require explicit user decisions or repair commands.</p>
</section>

<section id="architecture-constraints">
<h1>Architecture Constraints</h1>
<p>Taskledger operates under several fixed constraints that shape its architecture:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Python 3.10+ with minimal dependencies</strong>: The runtime depends only on <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typer</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">click</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PyYAML</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tomli</span></code> (Python &lt;3.11), and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> for atomic I/O, JSON I/O, YAML I/O, front matter parsing, and cross-ledger ref parsing. No database, no network server, no external service is required.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>File-system canonical storage</strong>: All durable state lives in the project Ledgercore mounts configured by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.toml</span></code>, as Markdown files with YAML front matter. This makes state inspectable, diffable, and version-controllable alongside source code.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>CLI-first with machine-readable JSON output</strong>: The primary interface is the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span></code> CLI command. Every command supports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> for structured output. The JSON envelope shape and exit codes are part of the public contract.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Skills outside the package</strong>: Agent skill files (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">skills/taskledger/SKILL.md</span></code>) live outside the Python package and are never packaged as Python package data. The package provides the CLI and library; skill distribution is separate.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Project-local configuration</strong>: Each project has its Ledgercore manifest at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.toml</span></code> and ledger-specific configuration under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/</span></code>. There is no global state or central server.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Source-first architecture records</strong>: Arc42 architecture records are stored in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/archledger/data</span></code> and are the source of truth for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/architecture.md</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/architecture_taskledger_split.md</span></code> is a concise human-maintained summary. Skills stay outside both the Python package and the archledger build output.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Python 3.10+ with minimal ledgercore-backed dependencies</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Impact: Limits runtime to Python 3.10+ with three dependencies; no database or native extensions.</p></li>
<li><p>Notes: Runtime dependencies are limited to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typer</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">click</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PyYAML</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tomli</span></code> (Python &lt;3.11 only), and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> (for atomic I/O, JSON I/O, YAML I/O, front matter parsing, and cross-ledger ref parsing). This constraint ensures easy installation in constrained environments (CI, containers, Termux) and avoids dependency conflicts with host projects. The trade-off is that features like full-text search use pure-Python implementations rather than native libraries.</p></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><p><strong>File-system canonical storage with sidecar summary index</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Impact: State is file-based; query performance depends on index rebuilds.</p></li>
<li><p>Notes: All durable state is stored as Markdown files with YAML front matter in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code>. This makes state human-readable, diffable in Git, and inspectable without taskledger. The trade-off is that query performance depends on file scanning and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index rebuilding rather than a database engine. The sidecar index is maintained in place by per-task sidecar writes and rebuilt from canonical records on miss.</p></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><p><strong>CLI-first with machine-readable JSON output</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Impact: JSON envelope shape and exit codes are public API contracts; breaking changes require version bumps.</p></li>
<li><p>Notes: The CLI is the primary interface. Every command supports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> for machine-readable output with a stable envelope shape (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ok</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">command</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_type</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">warnings</span></code>) and deterministic exit codes. This enables agent harnesses and CI pipelines to consume output programmatically without parsing human text.</p></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><p><strong>Skills must stay outside the Python package</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Impact: Skill distribution is separate from package distribution; skill installation is a distinct step.</p></li>
<li><p>Notes: Agent skill files (e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">skills/taskledger/SKILL.md</span></code>) live outside the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span></code> Python package. They are not packaged as package data, not loaded via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">importlib.resources</span></code>, and not distributed via PyPI. This separates the concerns of tool functionality (the package) from agent integration instructions (the skill).</p></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="context-and-scope">
<h1>Context and Scope</h1>
<p>Taskledger operates as a self-contained tool within a software development project. It interacts with four categories of external actors:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>Agent harnesses</strong> (pi, codex, chatgpt, and similar) invoke taskledger CLI commands to create tasks, propose plans, log implementation changes, run validation checks, and manage handoffs. They consume <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> output.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Human developers</strong> use the CLI directly in terminals for task creation, plan review, approval, lock management, and inspection (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor</span></code>).</p></li>
<li><p><strong>CI systems</strong> may invoke taskledger for status checks, validation, snapshot/export operations, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">trace</span></code> bundles.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Python library consumers</strong> import from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.api.*</span></code> to programmatically manage tasks without the CLI subprocess.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>The system boundary is the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> directory and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> config file at the project root. Everything inside <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> is taskledger-owned state. Everything outside is the host project source code. Taskledger does not depend on any external services, databases, or network endpoints. It reads the host project file system for search/symbol operations but does not modify files outside <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code>.</p>

<h2>Business Context</h2>

<section id="solution-strategy">
<h1>Solution Strategy</h1>
<p>Taskledger uses a layered architecture with clear dependency direction: upper layers depend on lower layers, never the reverse.</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>CLI Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli*.py</span></code>) — Typer commands that parse arguments, resolve task references, call service functions, and render output (human text or JSON).</p></li>
<li><p><strong>API Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/api/*.py</span></code>) — Stable public wrappers that mirror the CLI surface for programmatic use.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Services Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/*.py</span></code>) — Orchestration logic: lifecycle flows (planning, implementation, validation), handoff rendering, doctor checks, plan input validation, plan review, snapshot capture, dashboard assembly, and navigation.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Domain Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/*.py</span></code>) — Pure data models, state enums, normalization, and policy decisions. No I/O, no file system access.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Storage Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/*.py</span></code>) — File system operations: front matter read/write, atomic writes, lock files, sidecar index rebuilds, migrations. Storage delegates low-level primitives to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Key architectural choices:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Markdown and YAML front matter as canonical format</strong> — Each record (task, plan, run, lock, handoff, code review, etc.) is stored as a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.md</span></code> file with YAML front matter metadata and a Markdown body. This makes state human-readable and Git-friendly.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Sidecar indexes as derived caches</strong> — A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index lives under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code> and is rebuilt from canonical records. Per-task sidecar writes update the index in place.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Policy-based gate decisions</strong> — All lifecycle transitions go through functions in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/policies.py</span></code> that return <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Decision</span></code> objects with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">allowed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">message</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exit_code</span></code>. This keeps gate logic testable and separate from I/O.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Atomic file writes</strong> — All writes use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">atomic_write_text</span></code> (write to temp, fsync, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">os.replace</span></code>) from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Editable plan input with preflight</strong> — <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> parses editable plan input through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_input.py</span></code>, applies worker-pipeline validation, and returns indexed issues before any plan upsert.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Implementation workspace snapshots</strong> — <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/workspace_snapshot.py</span></code> captures Git and content snapshots when an implementation run starts, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> blocks when the workspace diverges. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code> records new snapshots with an audit trail.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Opaque cross-ledger references</strong> — Task refs, plan versions, file links, and external handoff targets are stored as opaque strings. Taskledger does not interpret ledgercore global refs, archledger IDs, or other external system identifiers.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Read-model reuse</strong> — <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">view</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tree</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor</span></code> consume service-level read models. These presentations are read-only and do not bypass lifecycle services.</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="maintenance">
<h2>Maintenance</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/architecture.md</span></code> is generated from Archledger source records. Do not edit it directly.</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Edit</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/archledger/data/profiles/arc42/sections/*.md</span></code> for section content and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/archledger/data/records/**/*.md</span></code> for individual records.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Regenerate</strong>: Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span></code> to regenerate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/architecture.md</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Verify</strong>: Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pytest</span> <span class="pre">-q</span> <span class="pre">tests/test_docs_and_skill.py</span> <span class="pre">tests/test_service_boundaries.py</span></code> after changes.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Authoritative source</strong>: The Archledger records under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/archledger/data</span></code> are the single source of truth for architecture documentation. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/architecture_taskledger_split.md</span></code> is a concise human-maintained summary.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="strategy-items">
<h2>Strategy Items</h2>
</section>
<section id="layered-architecture-cli-services-domain-storage">
<h2>Layered architecture: CLI → Services → Domain → Storage</h2>
<p><strong>Drivers:</strong> decoupled layers, testable services, fast agent integration
<strong>Constraints:</strong> no domain I/O, storage uses ledgercore primitives, bounded CLI filesystem use
<strong>Related ADRs:</strong> adr-0046, adr-0047, adr-0048, adr-0049, adr-0050, adr-0051</p>
</section>
<section id="strategy">
<h2>Strategy</h2>
<p>The codebase is organized into five layers with target dependency direction: CLI (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli*.py</span></code>) -&gt; API (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/api/</span></code>) -&gt; Services (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/</span></code>) -&gt; Domain (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/</span></code>) + Storage (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/</span></code>). The Domain layer has no I/O dependencies. Storage owns canonical taskledger persistence and atomic record I/O, delegating low-level primitives (atomic writes, JSON I/O, YAML I/O, front matter parsing, cross-ledger ref parsing) to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>. Other layers may perform bounded filesystem operations for external inputs and outputs (reports, Git sync, search, CLI file arguments). CLI should prefer API wrappers for public workflows, but current sanctioned exceptions are tracked in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tests/test_service_boundaries.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="trade-offs">
<h2>Trade-offs</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Clear separation of concerns enables focused testing per layer.</p></li>
<li><p>Service modules can grow large since they orchestrate across domain and storage.</p></li>
<li><p>No formal dependency injection; layer boundaries are enforced by convention and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">test_service_boundaries.py</span></code> test.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="markdown-yaml-front-matter-as-canonical-records">
<h2>Markdown/YAML front matter as canonical records</h2>
<p><strong>Drivers:</strong> human readable state, git diffable records, no database dependency
<strong>Constraints:</strong> strict front matter validation, ledgercore front matter parsing, storage layout v3
<strong>Related ADRs:</strong> adr-0046, adr-0050</p>
</section>
<section id="id1">
<h2>Strategy</h2>
<p>Each persistent record (task, plan, run, lock, handoff, event, etc.) is stored as a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.md</span></code> file with YAML front matter for structured metadata and a Markdown body for free-form content. This format is human-readable, Git-diffable, and editable without taskledger. The front matter serialization is handled by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/frontmatter.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="id2">
<h2>Trade-offs</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Slower to parse than JSON or SQLite for large datasets.</p></li>
<li><p>State is transparent and version-controllable — a core design goal.</p></li>
<li><p>Schema evolution requires careful front matter validation (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_require_contract</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_string_value</span></code>, etc.).</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="json-indexes-as-rebuildable-derived-caches">
<h2>JSON indexes as rebuildable derived caches</h2>
<p><strong>Drivers:</strong> fast list and query operations, canonical records remain source of truth
<strong>Constraints:</strong> summary index rebuildable on miss, reindex after out of band changes
<strong>Related ADRs:</strong> adr-0047</p>
</section>
<section id="id3">
<h2>Strategy</h2>
<p>A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code> is a derived cache rebuilt from canonical Markdown records by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">reindex</span></code>. Per-task sidecar writes call <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">update_sidecar_summary</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/sidecar_index.py</span></code> so the index stays current. The index speeds up list and query operations but is never authoritative. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span> <span class="pre">indexes</span></code> checks for staleness.</p>
</section>
<section id="id4">
<h2>Trade-offs</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Avoids the complexity of a query engine on front matter files.</p></li>
<li><p>Indexes can become stale if writes bypass taskledger (for example manual edits). <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reindex</span></code> address this.</p></li>
<li><p>The summary index is a JSON document with a schema version and an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">object_type</span></code> field; it is rebuildable from canonical records.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="policy-based-lifecycle-gate-decisions">
<h2>Policy-based lifecycle gate decisions</h2>
<p><strong>Drivers:</strong> testable gate logic, user only actions enforced
<strong>Constraints:</strong> PolicyContext is gathered explicitly, no I/O in policy functions
<strong>Related ADRs:</strong> adr-0048</p>
</section>
<section id="id5">
<h2>Strategy</h2>
<p>All lifecycle transitions are validated through pure functions in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/policies.py</span></code> that return <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Decision</span></code> objects (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">allowed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">message</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exit_code</span></code>). Policies have no I/O — they receive <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PolicyContext</span></code> (task, lock, run) and return a decision. This makes gate logic fully testable without file system setup.</p>
</section>
<section id="id6">
<h2>Trade-offs</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Policy functions must receive all context explicitly (no lazy loading from storage).</p></li>
<li><p>Very testable: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">test_domain_policies.py</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">test_lifecycle_policies.py</span></code> cover the full decision surface.</p></li>
<li><p>Services must gather the right context before calling policies.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="atomic-file-writes-for-durability">
<h2>Atomic file writes for durability</h2>
<p><strong>Drivers:</strong> durability of canonical records, no partial writes
<strong>Constraints:</strong> ledgercore atomic primitives, fsync overhead, TASKLEDGER_TEST_FAST_IO escape hatch
<strong>Related ADRs:</strong> adr-0046</p>
</section>
<section id="id7">
<h2>Strategy</h2>
<p>All file writes go through the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> atomic primitives used by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/atomic.py</span></code>: write to a temp file in the target directory, flush plus fsync, then <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">os.replace</span></code> for atomic rename. Directory fsync follows. Lock creation uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">atomic_create_text</span></code> with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">O_CREAT</span> <span class="pre">|</span> <span class="pre">O_EXCL</span></code> for exclusive creation. These patterns prevent partial or corrupt writes on crash.</p>
</section>
<section id="id8">
<h2>Trade-offs</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Slightly slower than direct writes due to temp file plus fsync overhead.</p></li>
<li><p>Can be disabled for testing via the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TASKLEDGER_TEST_FAST_IO</span></code> environment variable.</p></li>
<li><p>Guarantees that readers always see complete, valid files.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
<section id="building-block-view">
<h1>Building Block View</h1>
<p>The top-level building block is the <strong>taskledger system</strong>, decomposed into five black-box components:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>CLI Layer</strong> — Handles command parsing, task reference resolution, and output rendering. Command families cover the canonical lifecycle plus <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span></code>, task archive operations, transfer and sync, diagnostics, the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor</span></code> observer, and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipeline</span></code> overlay.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>API Layer</strong> — Provides stable Python function wrappers around service operations.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Services Layer</strong> — Orchestrates lifecycle flows, plan input validation, plan review, handoffs, snapshot capture, navigation, doctor checks, worker pipelines, archival, code-review evidence, event logging, exports, dashboard assembly, and ready-work inspection.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Domain Layer</strong> — Defines models, state machines, and policy decisions.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Storage Layer</strong> — Manages file system persistence and layout. Low-level primitives (atomic writes, JSON, YAML, front matter, refs) are delegated to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Data flows strictly downward: CLI -&gt; Services -&gt; Domain + Storage. The API layer calls Services directly. The Domain layer has no dependencies on Storage or Services.</p>
<p>Each task is stored as a <strong>task bundle directory</strong> under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code> containing the task record (Markdown) and sidecar collections for plans, runs, locks, todos, questions, changes, checks, handoffs, links, and code reviews. Mutations append immutable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TaskEvent</span></code> records to the ledger-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events/</span></code> directory. Action and event logging is enabled by default; set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[event_logging]</span> <span class="pre">enabled</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">false</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> to disable new event records. Existing records remain readable regardless. A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index under the same ledger path is maintained as a derived cache of sidecar counts and lock summaries.</p>
<section id="whitebox-taskledger-system">
<h2>Whitebox taskledger system</h2>
</section>
<section id="motivation">
<h2>Motivation</h2>
<p>Taskledger decomposes into core layers with downward dependency flow. This isolates persistence, business rules, orchestration, and public interfaces. Low-level persistence primitives are delegated to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>, but the layer boundary above it stays in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="contained-building-blocks">
<h2>Contained building blocks</h2>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>CLI Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">block-0030</span></code>) — Typer commands, argument parsing, output rendering</p></li>
<li><p><strong>API Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">block-0031</span></code>) — Stable Python function wrappers</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Services Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">block-0032</span></code>) — Lifecycle orchestration, handoffs, plan input, plan review, snapshots, inspection</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Domain Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">block-0033</span></code>) — Models, state machines, policies (no I/O)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Storage Layer</strong> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">block-0034</span></code>) — File system persistence, atomic writes, sidecar index, layout</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="important-interfaces">
<h2>Important interfaces</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>CLI -&gt; Services: function calls with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_root</span></code> plus task references</p></li>
<li><p>Services -&gt; Domain: policy functions take <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PolicyContext</span></code>, return <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Decision</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Services -&gt; Storage: record CRUD operations through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_store.py</span></code> functions and the sidecar index</p></li>
<li><p>API -&gt; Services: direct function calls mirroring CLI behavior</p></li>
<li><p>Storage -&gt; ledgercore: atomic I/O, JSON I/O, YAML I/O, front matter parsing, cross-ledger ref parsing</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="level-1">
<h3>Level 1</h3>
<section id="cli-layer">
<h4>CLI Layer</h4>
<p><strong>Parent:</strong> block-0029
<strong>Interfaces:</strong>
<strong>Location:</strong></p>
<p>Handles command parsing via Typer, task reference resolution (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--task</span></code> option, active task default), and output rendering (human text or JSON envelope via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cli_common.py</span></code>). Command families include the canonical lifecycle plus <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span></code>, task archive operations, transfer and sync, diagnostics, the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor</span></code> observer, the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipeline</span></code> overlay, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ref</span></code> cross-ledger helpers.</p>
<p>Source refs: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_common.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/command_inventory.py</span></code>, and the focused <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_*.py</span></code> registration modules.</p>
</section>
<section id="api-layer">
<h4>API Layer</h4>
<p><strong>Parent:</strong> block-0029
<strong>Interfaces:</strong>
<strong>Location:</strong></p>
<p>Stable Python function wrappers under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/api/</span></code> that mirror the CLI surface for programmatic use. Each module (tasks, plans, handoff, locks, task runs, sync, reviews, search, etc.) exposes functions that accept workspace paths and return dictionaries matching the JSON output shape. The API layer calls Services directly.</p>
</section>
<section id="services-layer">
<h4>Services Layer</h4>
<p><strong>Parent:</strong> block-0029
<strong>Interfaces:</strong>
<strong>Location:</strong></p>
<p>Orchestrates lifecycle flows by coordinating Domain policies and records with Storage. Focused services own planning (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planning_flow.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_input.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_review.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_lint.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_materialization.py</span></code>), implementation (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementation_flow.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_snapshot.py</span></code>), validation (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validation_flow.py</span></code>), handoffs (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff_lifecycle.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_context.py</span></code>), doctor checks (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor_checks/</span></code>), navigation (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">navigation.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_action_model.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_action_payload.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ready_work.py</span></code>), worker pipelines (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_pipeline.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workflow_guidance.py</span></code>), archival (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_archive.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_export.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_reports.py</span></code>), code-review evidence (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code_review.py</span></code>), event logging (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_events.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">agent_transcripts.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">agent_logging.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">change_tracking.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">check_tracking.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">event_logging.py</span></code>), exports and dashboard assembly (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dashboard.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tree.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor.py</span></code>). <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tasks.py</span></code> remains the compatibility-oriented lifecycle facade while ownership is progressively extracted into focused modules.</p>
</section>
<section id="domain-layer">
<h4>Domain Layer</h4>
<p><strong>Parent:</strong> block-0029
<strong>Interfaces:</strong>
<strong>Location:</strong></p>
<p>Data models, state enums, normalization, and policy decisions without storage I/O. Besides lifecycle and sidecar records, the domain defines append-only code-review records. State transitions remain in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">states.py</span></code>; policy decisions in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">policies.py</span></code> return structured <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Decision</span></code> objects. The canonical storage layout version is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TASKLEDGER_STORAGE_LAYOUT_VERSION</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/states.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="storage-layer">
<h4>Storage Layer</h4>
<p><strong>Parent:</strong> block-0029
<strong>Interfaces:</strong>
<strong>Location:</strong></p>
<p>File system persistence for canonical records. Storage layout keeps each task in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/tasks/&lt;task-id&gt;/</span></code>, with independently addressable sidecars including plans, runs, locks, todos, questions, changes, checks, handoffs, links, and code reviews. Ledger-level collections hold events, introductions, releases, and rebuildable indexes. A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index is maintained as a derived cache; per-task sidecar writes call <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">update_sidecar_summary</span></code> from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/sidecar_index.py</span></code> so the read path does not need a full rescan. Atomic write primitives, YAML I/O, front matter parsing, and ref parsing are delegated to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>. Action and event logging is enabled by default and can be disabled in project config. Project config edits use structured TOML handling rather than ad hoc text replacement.</p>
</section>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<section id="runtime-view">
<h1>Runtime View</h1>
<p>The runtime view traces the main operational scenarios through the system:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>Task lifecycle</strong> — A task is created in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">draft</span></code>, moves to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planning</span></code> (lock acquired, run started), then <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_review</span></code> after a plan is proposed. The user approves -&gt; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">approved</span></code>. Implementation starts -&gt; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementing</span></code>, finishes -&gt; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implemented</span></code>. Validation starts -&gt; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validating</span></code>, passes -&gt; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Plan input flow</strong> — <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> opens planning. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">guidance</span></code> reports the active project planning profile. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">template</span></code> writes a fresh plan skeleton; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">--file</span> <span class="pre">plan.md</span></code> runs the preflight parser in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_input.py</span></code> without mutating state. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">upsert</span> <span class="pre">--file</span> <span class="pre">plan.md</span></code> (or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--from-answers</span></code>) persists the plan; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">lint</span> <span class="pre">--version</span> <span class="pre">N</span></code> surfaces blocking issues; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">review</span> <span class="pre">--version</span> <span class="pre">N</span></code> produces the approval brief; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">accept</span> <span class="pre">--version</span> <span class="pre">N</span> <span class="pre">--note</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code> records the user-only decision.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Implementation workspace snapshot</strong> — <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> captures a Git and content snapshot in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/workspace_snapshot.py</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> blocks when the current workspace diverges from the implementation snapshot. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code> records a new snapshot with an audit trail and is the normal recovery path when validation is blocked by snapshot mismatch.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Lock lifecycle</strong> — Starting a stage (planning, implementation, validation) acquires a lock and creates a run. Locks have lease timers and heartbeats. Stale locks require explicit break flow with audit trail.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Handoff flow</strong> — A worker creates a handoff with generated context (task state, plan, todos, questions, lock info). Another worker claims it, optionally transferring the lock. The handoff is closed when the receiving worker completes.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Doctor checks</strong> — Inspects lock/run consistency, front matter integrity, index staleness, and storage layout version. Reports diagnostics with severity, code, and repair hints.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Validation evidence flow</strong> — Acceptance criteria from the accepted plan are checked during the validation stage. Evidence is recorded per criterion with pass/fail/warn status. Latest-check-wins semantics apply; mandatory criteria gate completion.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Code-review evidence</strong> — A reviewer records append-only review evidence against an implementation run, handoff, worker step, working tree, or commit. This is evidence attached to the task, not a new lifecycle stage.</p></li>
</ol>
<section id="task-lifecycle-create-through-done">
<h2>Task lifecycle: create through done</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: User or agent runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">create</span></code>.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">create</span></code> → TaskRecord persisted in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">draft</span></code> stage with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task.created</span></code> event</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> → Lock acquired, planning run started, stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planning</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">propose</span></code> → PlanRecord persisted, todos materialized, stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_review</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">approve</span></code> (user-only) → Stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">approved</span></code>, lock released, run finished</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> → Lock acquired, implementation run started, stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementing</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">log</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code> → Changes logged, todos completed, stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implemented</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> → Lock acquired, validation run started, stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validating</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code> → Criteria checked, stage → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code> (or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">failed_validation</span></code>)</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Task reaches <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code> with all todos complete and all mandatory criteria passed. Events trail the full history.</p>
<p><strong>Key policy checks</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">can_start_planning</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_propose_decision</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_approve_decision</span></code>, implementation requires accepted plan, validation requires finished implementation run.</p>
</section>
<section id="lock-acquisition-heartbeat-and-release">
<h2>Lock acquisition, heartbeat, and release</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Service calls <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_start_run</span></code> (e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code>).</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Check no existing active lock for the task</p></li>
<li><p>Create <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TaskLock</span></code> record via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">atomic_create_text</span></code> (exclusive file creation)</p></li>
<li><p>Create <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TaskRunRecord</span></code> with status <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">running</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Append <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock.acquired</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">run.started</span></code> events</p></li>
<li><p>Update task stage to active stage (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planning</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementing</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validating</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p>Heartbeat updates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">last_heartbeat_at</span></code> on the lock</p></li>
<li><p>On finish: run status → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">finished</span></code>, lock removed, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock.released</span></code> event appended</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Stale lock handling</strong>:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock_is_expired</span></code> checks lease expiry</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock</span> <span class="pre">break</span></code> requires explicit user action, records <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">broken_at</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">broken_by</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">broken_reason</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span></code> detects lock/run mismatches</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/tasks.py</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_start_run</span></code>), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/locks.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/lock.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="handoff-creation-and-claiming">
<h2>Handoff creation and claiming</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Worker runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">handoff</span> <span class="pre">create</span></code>.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Generate context body: task state, accepted plan, todos, questions, lock/run status, implementation summary, validation status</p></li>
<li><p>Create <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TaskHandoffRecord</span></code> with mode (planning/implementation/validation/review/full), lock policy (none/retain/release/transfer), intended actor and harness</p></li>
<li><p>Persist handoff record, append <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff.created</span></code> event</p></li>
<li><p>Another worker runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff</span> <span class="pre">claim</span></code> → status → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">claimed</span></code>, optional lock transfer</p></li>
<li><p>Worker completes work, runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff</span> <span class="pre">close</span></code> → status → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">closed</span></code></p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/handoff.py</span></code> (context generation), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/handoff_lifecycle.py</span></code> (claim/close/transfer), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/worker_context.py</span></code> (context assembly).</p>
</section>
<section id="editable-plan-input-preflight">
<h2>Editable plan input preflight</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Agent or user edits a plan file and runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">upsert</span></code>.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">--file</span> <span class="pre">plan.md</span></code> -&gt; Pure preflight parser in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_input.py</span></code> returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_input_check</span></code> payload with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">passed</span></code>, indexed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issues</span></code>, and parsed counts. No state mutation.</p></li>
<li><p>Worker-pipeline configuration in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> is consulted to validate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_step</span></code> todo tags when present.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">upsert</span> <span class="pre">--file</span> <span class="pre">plan.md</span></code> (or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--from-answers</span></code>) runs the same parser, persists the plan as a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanRecord</span></code>, and materializes todos.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">lint</span> <span class="pre">--version</span> <span class="pre">N</span></code> runs structural lint over the proposed plan body and front matter.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">review</span> <span class="pre">--version</span> <span class="pre">N</span></code> renders the approval brief used by the user-only approval command.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Plan is persisted with no parse errors, no lint errors, and no stale answers. Approval can proceed.</p>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_input.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_lint.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_review.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_plan.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="doctor-integrity-check">
<h2>Doctor integrity check</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: User runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span></code>.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Resolve project paths and locator</p></li>
<li><p>Check storage layout version against current version</p></li>
<li><p>Scan all tasks: verify front matter validity, lock/run consistency, active task state</p></li>
<li><p>Check index staleness (comparing index contents against canonical records)</p></li>
<li><p>Check for stale locks (expired leases)</p></li>
<li><p>Collect structured diagnostics with severity, code, message, and repair hints</p></li>
<li><p>Report diagnostics to user (human text or JSON)</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor_checks/task_checks.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor_checks/project_scan.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor_checks/migration_checks.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="branch-scoped-ledger-selection-and-fork">
<h2>Branch-scoped ledger selection and fork</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Developer creates a long-lived Git branch and runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">ledger</span> <span class="pre">fork</span> <span class="pre">REF</span></code>.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger</span> <span class="pre">fork</span> <span class="pre">feature-a</span></code> → Creates a new ledger directory under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/feature-a/</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Commits the updated <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> (with new <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger_ref</span></code>) with the branch work</p></li>
<li><p>Default commands now read/write only the current ledger under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Tasks in different ledgers are isolated; duplicate logical task IDs are expected across ledgers</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger</span> <span class="pre">adopt</span> <span class="pre">--from</span> <span class="pre">feature-a</span> <span class="pre">task-0030</span></code> copies a branch-local task into the current ledger when merging</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Each long-lived branch has its own isolated task ledger. The active ledger is determined by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger_ref</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code>.</p>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_ledger.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/ledger_config.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/task_store.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="implementation-workspace-snapshot-lifecycle">
<h2>Implementation workspace snapshot lifecycle</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> captures a workspace snapshot; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> enforces it before validation runs.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> -&gt; Acquires implementation lock, creates an implementation run, calls <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">capture_workspace_content_snapshot</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/workspace_snapshot.py</span></code>, and persists snapshot metadata on the run.</p></li>
<li><p>Implementation finishes via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code>. The snapshot is the source of truth for what was implemented.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> -&gt; Calls <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compare_implementation_snapshot</span></code>. If the current workspace diverges, validation is blocked with a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reason_code</span></code> such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">content_snapshot_mismatch</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">legacy_snapshot_mismatch</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span> <span class="pre">--refresh-implementation-snapshot</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code> -&gt; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">refresh_implementation_snapshot</span></code> records a new snapshot, appends an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementation.snapshot.refreshed</span></code> event, and resumes the normal validation flow.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code> is the same recovery path when called outside <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code>.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Validation only proceeds when the current workspace matches the implementation snapshot; otherwise an explicit refresh with audit trail is required.</p>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/workspace_snapshot.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/implementation_flow.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/validation_flow.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_implement.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="git-sync-workflow-for-shared-state">
<h2>Git sync workflow for shared state</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Developer runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">init</span></code> to set up an external sync repo.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">init</span></code> → Moves or copies <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> content into a dedicated Git repository, updates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">external_dir</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">preflight</span></code> → Checks that no active locks would conflict with a sync operation</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">commit</span> <span class="pre">--message</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code> → Commits current state to the sync repo</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">export-local</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">import-local</span></code> → Exchanges state between the sync repo and the project</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">status</span></code> → Shows working tree status of the sync repo</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">paths</span></code> → Shows resolved paths for the sync repo and project</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cd</span> <span class="pre">&quot;$(taskledger</span> <span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">cd)&quot;</span></code> → Opens a shell in the sync repo directory for manual Git operations</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Taskledger state is stored in a separate Git repository that can be versioned and shared manually. The design intentionally avoids automated push/pull to prevent merge conflicts — users run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">push</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">pull</span></code> directly in the sync repo.</p>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/git_sync.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_sync.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/api/sync.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="migration-reindex-and-doctor-interaction">
<h2>Migration, reindex, and doctor interaction</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Developer upgrades taskledger and runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span></code>, which reports a storage version mismatch.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span></code> → Scans project config, storage layout version, task records, indexes, locks, and runs</p></li>
<li><p>Detects that storage layout version (e.g., v2) is behind current version (v3)</p></li>
<li><p>Reports diagnostic with severity, code, and repair hint</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migrate</span></code> → Applies storage layout migrations to upgrade records to current schema</p></li>
<li><p>Migration code in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/migrations.py</span></code> handles version-to-version upgrades</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reindex</span></code> → Rebuilds JSON index caches from migrated canonical records</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span></code> → Re-run confirms all checks pass</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Storage layout is upgraded to the current version. Indexes are rebuilt. Doctor passes cleanly.</p>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/migrations.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor_checks/migration_checks.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/states.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="worker-pipeline-guided-handoff">
<h2>Worker pipeline guided handoff</h2>
<p><strong>Trigger</strong>: Agent runs <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">next-action</span></code> and receives <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_pipeline.next_step</span></code> in the response.</p>
<p><strong>Flow</strong>:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> → Returns <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_pipeline.next_step</span></code> with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">step_id</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context_command</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff_command</span></code> hints</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipeline</span> <span class="pre">show</span></code> → Displays the configured worker pipeline steps and their mapping to lifecycle stages</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context</span> <span class="pre">--worker</span> <span class="pre">spec-reviewer</span></code> → Renders a worker-specific context for the spec reviewer step</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff</span> <span class="pre">create</span> <span class="pre">--worker</span> <span class="pre">code-reviewer</span></code> → Creates a handoff with mode and context derived from the worker step configuration</p></li>
<li><p>Plan todos may be tagged with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_step</span></code> to associate implementation steps with specific pipeline workers</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">template</span> <span class="pre">--with-worker-pipeline</span></code> → Generates plan template with worker-tagged todo sections</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Result</strong>: Worker pipeline provides an advisory overlay that guides fresh-context handoffs through sequential worker steps (spec-reviewer, implementer, code-reviewer). It does not add new lifecycle gates — the task lifecycle remains the authoritative workflow.</p>
<p><strong>Key source</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/worker_pipeline.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_pipeline.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/handoff.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="deployment-view">
<h1>Deployment View</h1>
<p>Taskledger is a single-node, file-system-based tool. Deployment consists of:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Installation</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pip</span> <span class="pre">install</span> <span class="pre">taskledger</span></code> (PyPI) or local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pip</span> <span class="pre">install</span> <span class="pre">-e</span> <span class="pre">.</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><strong>Project initialization</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">init</span></code> creates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> in the project root</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Runtime</strong>: The CLI runs as a Python process, reading and writing the project <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> directory. No daemon, no server.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>CI integration</strong>: taskledger commands can be run in CI pipelines for status checks, validation, snapshot and export operations, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">trace</span></code> bundles</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Agent integration</strong>: Agent harnesses invoke taskledger CLI commands as subprocess calls</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="local-development-deployment">
<h2>Local development deployment</h2>
<p><strong>Node</strong>: Developer workstation or CI runner.</p>
<p><strong>Software</strong>:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Python 3.10+</p></li>
<li><p>taskledger (pip installed)</p></li>
<li><p>Host project with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> config</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Storage</strong>:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> directory in project root (Markdown and YAML front matter files)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Project config at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Network</strong>: None required.</p>
<p><strong>Installation</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pip</span> <span class="pre">install</span> <span class="pre">taskledger</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pip</span> <span class="pre">install</span> <span class="pre">-e</span> <span class="pre">.</span></code> from source. Single entry point: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span></code> CLI.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="cross-cutting-concepts">
<h1>Cross-cutting Concepts</h1>
<p>Cross-cutting concerns that span multiple layers:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Actor metadata</strong>: Every mutation carries an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ActorRef</span></code> (type: agent/user/system, name, role, session, harness). Decisions distinguish user-only actions (approval, waiver) from agent actions.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>JSON output envelope</strong>: All CLI commands emit a consistent JSON envelope with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ok</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">command</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_type</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">warnings</span></code> fields when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> is passed. Error envelopes add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">message</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">details</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">remediation</span></code>.</p></li>
