<li><p><strong>YAML front matter serialization</strong>: All canonical records use YAML front matter (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">---</span></code> delimited) for metadata and Markdown for body. Serialization and deserialization live in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/frontmatter.py</span></code>, backed by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Atomic file writes</strong>: All file writes go through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> atomic primitives (temp file, flush, fsync, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">os.replace</span></code>, directory fsync) to prevent corruption.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Action and event logging (default-on)</strong>: Mutations append immutable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TaskEvent</span></code> records to the ledger-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events/</span></code> directory under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code>. Action and event logging is enabled by default; set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[event_logging]</span> <span class="pre">enabled</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">false</span></code> to disable new records. Existing records remain readable. Source: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/events.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/task_events.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/event.py</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Exit code taxonomy</strong>: Errors map to stable exit codes (0=success, 1=generic, 2=bad input, 3=workflow rejection, 4=lock conflict, 5=missing, 6=storage, 7=validation failed).</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Opaque cross-ledger references</strong>: Task refs, plan versions, file links, and handoff targets remain opaque strings. Taskledger does not interpret ledgercore global refs, archledger IDs, SpecWeave feature paths, or other external system identifiers.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Read-model reuse</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">view</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tree</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor</span></code> commands consume service-level read models. These presentations are read-only and do not bypass lifecycle services.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Editable plan input</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> is a pure preflight parser in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_input.py</span></code>. It rejects malformed YAML, normalizes the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">description</span></code> alias to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>, and surfaces indexed issues before any plan upsert. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">lint</span></code> runs additional structural checks; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">review</span></code> renders the approval brief.</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="actor-metadata-and-role-semantics">
<h2>Actor metadata and role semantics</h2>
<p>Every mutation carries an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ActorRef</span></code> (type: agent/user/system, name, role, session ID, harness ID) and optionally a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">HarnessRef</span></code> (harness identity, kind, capabilities). The system distinguishes user-only actions (plan approval, criterion waivers, dependency waivers) from agent actions. Actor metadata is persisted in locks, runs, events, and handoff records for audit trails. Source: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/actor.py</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ActorRef</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">HarnessRef</span></code>), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/states.py</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ActorType</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ActorRole</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">HarnessKind</span></code>).</p>
</section>
<section id="json-output-envelope-contract">
<h2>JSON output envelope contract</h2>
<p>When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> is passed, every CLI command emits a JSON envelope: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">{&quot;ok&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">bool,</span> <span class="pre">&quot;command&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">str,</span> <span class="pre">&quot;result_type&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">str,</span> <span class="pre">&quot;result&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">...,</span> <span class="pre">&quot;events&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">[...],</span> <span class="pre">&quot;warnings&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">[...]}</span></code>. On error, the envelope includes an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">error</span></code> object with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">message</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">details</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">remediation</span></code> fields. This shape is a public API contract tested by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tests/test_json_contracts.py</span></code>. Exit codes map deterministically to error categories and are part of the public contract.</p>
</section>
<section id="yaml-front-matter-serialization">
<h2>YAML front matter serialization</h2>
<p>All canonical records are <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.md</span></code> files with YAML front matter (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">---</span></code> delimited) containing structured metadata and a Markdown body. Read and write are handled by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">read_markdown_front_matter</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">write_markdown_front_matter</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/frontmatter.py</span></code>, backed by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore.frontmatter</span></code>. Models implement <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">to_dict()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">from_dict()</span></code> for serialization. Schema version and object type fields enforce contract integrity on read.</p>
</section>
<section id="atomic-file-writes">
<h2>Atomic file writes</h2>
<p>All file writes go through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">atomic_write_text</span></code> (temp file, flush, fsync, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">os.replace</span></code>, directory fsync) or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">atomic_create_text</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">O_CREAT</span> <span class="pre">|</span> <span class="pre">O_EXCL</span></code> for lock files). These primitives come from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore.atomic</span></code> and are re-exported by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/atomic.py</span></code>. This prevents partial writes on crash. Test environments can disable fsync via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TASKLEDGER_TEST_FAST_IO=1</span></code> for speed.</p>
</section>
<section id="append-only-event-log">
<h2>Append-only event log</h2>
<p>Mutations append an immutable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TaskEvent</span></code> record to the ledger-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events/</span></code> directory under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code>. Action and event logging is enabled by default; set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[event_logging]</span> <span class="pre">enabled</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">false</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> to disable new event records. Existing records remain readable regardless of the setting. Events are never modified or deleted. Each event has a deterministic ID, name (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task.created</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan.approved</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock.acquired</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validation.check.logged</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code_review.recorded</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementation.snapshot.refreshed</span></code>), timestamp, and actor metadata. Events support audit trails, monitor activity, handoff context, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">transcript</span></code> output. Duplicate event detection prevents re-appending on retry. Source: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/events.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/task_events.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/agent_logging.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/agent_transcripts.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/event.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="exit-code-taxonomy">
<h2>Exit code taxonomy</h2>
<p>Stable exit codes for CLI and error classification: 0 (success), 1 (generic failure), 2 (bad input), 3 (workflow rejection - invalid transition, approval required, dependency blocked), 4 (lock conflict - stale lock requires break), 5 (not found or no active task), 6 (storage error or data integrity), 7 (validation failed). Defined in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/states.py</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/errors.py</span></code>. Agents and CI pipelines rely on specific codes for automation.</p>
</section>
<section id="id9">
<h2>Editable plan input preflight</h2>
<p>Editable plan input is a preflight parser in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/plan_input.py</span></code>. It accepts YAML front matter with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">goal</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">files</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">test_commands</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">expected_outputs</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">acceptance_criteria</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todos</span></code>, plus optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">generation_reason</span></code> and waiver reason fields. Criterion <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">description</span></code> is normalized to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code> as a compatibility alias. Worker-pipeline configuration in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> validates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_step</span></code> todo tags. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">--file</span> <span class="pre">plan.md</span></code> returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_input_check</span></code> payload with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">passed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">summary</span></code>, indexed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issues</span></code>, and parsed counts. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">upsert</span></code> consumes the same parser; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">lint</span></code> runs additional structural checks; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">review</span></code> renders the approval brief.</p>
</section>
<section id="implementation-workspace-snapshot">
<h2>Implementation workspace snapshot</h2>
<p>When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> is called, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/workspace_snapshot.py</span></code> captures a Git and content snapshot of the implementation workspace. The content snapshot (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worktree-content:v1</span></code>) records per-path status, kind, size, and content hash for files outside <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code>. The implementation run persists <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_git_commit</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_dirty</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_diff_hash</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_status_hash</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_snapshot_at</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_content_hash</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_paths_hash</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_entry_count</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_snapshot_format</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">workspace_snapshot_ref</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> calls <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compare_implementation_snapshot</span></code> and blocks validation when the current workspace diverges. The sanctioned recovery path is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code>, which records a new snapshot, appends an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementation.snapshot.refreshed</span></code> event, and returns a structured payload with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">old_snapshot</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">new_snapshot</span></code> details.</p>
</section>
<section id="durable-code-review-evidence">
<h2>Durable code-review evidence</h2>
<p>Code review is durable evidence attached to a task. A record captures result, summary/body, reviewer and harness, implementation run, worker step, handoff, and optional Git working-tree or commit metadata. Review records are append-only and may be recorded after a task reaches <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code>. They do not create a lifecycle stage, reopen completed work, replace acceptance criteria, or weaken validation completion rules. Source: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/review.py</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/code_review.py</span></code>. Test coverage: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tests/test_code_reviews.py</span></code>.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="architecture-decisions">
<h1>Architecture Decisions</h1>
<p>Key architecture decisions documented as ADR records:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>ADR-1</strong>: Markdown and YAML front matter as canonical format (not JSON, not SQLite)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ADR-2</strong>: Sidecar summary index as derived rebuildable cache (not authoritative)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ADR-3</strong>: Explicit lifecycle gates with policy decisions (not free-form state)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ADR-4</strong>: Typer CLI framework (not argparse, not Click directly)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ADR-5</strong>: Task bundle directory layout (not single-file index)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ADR-6</strong>: External skill packaging (skills outside the Python package)</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="markdown-yaml-front-matter-as-canonical-format">
<h2>Markdown/YAML front matter as canonical format</h2>
<p><strong>Document version:</strong> 5</p>
</section>
<section id="context">
<h2>Context</h2>
<p>Need a storage format for task state that is durable, human-readable, and version-controllable. Agents and humans need to inspect state without running taskledger.</p>
</section>
<section id="decision">
<h2>Decision</h2>
<p>Store all records as Markdown files with YAML front matter (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">---</span></code> delimited). Metadata (ID, type, status, dates) goes in YAML; free-form content goes in Markdown body.</p>
</section>
<section id="consequences">
<h2>Consequences</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Positive: State is Git-diffable, human-readable, and editable in any text editor.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: No database dependency.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Parsing is slower than binary formats for large datasets.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Schema evolution requires careful validation on read.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="alternatives-considered">
<h2>Alternatives considered</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>SQLite: Faster queries but opaque binary format, harder to version-control and inspect.</p></li>
<li><p>Pure JSON: Easier parsing but not human-friendly for long-form content (plan bodies, handoff contexts).</p></li>
<li><p>Single JSON index file: Rejected due to merge conflicts and scalability concerns.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="sidecar-summary-index-as-derived-rebuildable-cache">
<h2>Sidecar summary index as derived rebuildable cache</h2>
<p><strong>Document version:</strong> 5</p>
</section>
<section id="id10">
<h2>Context</h2>
<p>Listing tasks, locks, and dependencies requires scanning many front matter files. Need a way to speed up queries without adding a database.</p>
</section>
<section id="id11">
<h2>Decision</h2>
<p>Maintain JSON index files under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/indexes/</span></code> as derived caches. They are rebuilt from canonical records by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">reindex</span></code> and checked by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span> <span class="pre">indexes</span></code>. They are never the source of truth.</p>
</section>
<section id="id12">
<h2>Consequences</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Positive: Fast list/query operations without parsing all front matter files.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: Indexes can always be rebuilt from canonical source.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Indexes can become stale after manual edits or crashes.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reindex</span></code> must be run after out-of-band changes.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id13">
<h2>Alternatives considered</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>No indexes (always scan files): Simpler but too slow for large projects.</p></li>
<li><p>SQLite index: More robust but adds complexity and dependency.</p></li>
<li><p>In-memory cache: Lost on process restart, not durable.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="explicit-lifecycle-gates-with-policy-decisions">
<h2>Explicit lifecycle gates with policy decisions</h2>
<p><strong>Document version:</strong> 5</p>
</section>
<section id="id14">
<h2>Context</h2>
<p>Without lifecycle gates, agents could skip review and implement without approval. Need enforceable transitions between task stages.</p>
</section>
<section id="id15">
<h2>Decision</h2>
<p>Implement lifecycle gates as pure policy functions in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/policies.py</span></code>. Each gate function takes a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PolicyContext</span></code> (task, lock, run) and returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Decision</span></code> (allowed, code, message, exit_code). The state machine in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">states.py</span></code> defines <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ALLOWED_STAGE_TRANSITIONS</span></code>. Services call policies before mutating state.</p>
</section>
<section id="id16">
<h2>Consequences</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Positive: Gate logic is fully testable without I/O setup.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: User-only actions (approval, waivers) are enforced at the policy level.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Services must gather full context before calling policies.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id17">
<h2>Alternatives considered</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Free-form state changes: Rejected — agents could bypass review.</p></li>
<li><p>Database triggers: Rejected — adds database dependency and complexity.</p></li>
<li><p>CLI-only validation: Rejected — API and programmatic users would bypass gates.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="typer-cli-framework">
<h2>Typer CLI framework</h2>
<p><strong>Document version:</strong> 5</p>
</section>
<section id="id18">
<h2>Context</h2>
<p>Need a CLI framework that supports subcommand groups, type-annotated parameters, and integrates with Click ecosystem extensions.</p>
</section>
<section id="id19">
<h2>Decision</h2>
<p>Use Typer (built on Click) for the CLI. Typer provides type-annotated parameters, subcommand groups, and automatic help generation. The root app in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cli.py</span></code> registers nested Typer apps for each command family: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">question</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">intro</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">file</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">link</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">require</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">storage</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">repair</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migrate</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">actor</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">harness</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipeline</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ref</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="id20">
<h2>Consequences</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Positive: Clean type-annotated parameter definitions with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Annotated</span></code> types.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: Click ecosystem compatibility (middleware, testing).</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Typer and Click are both runtime dependencies.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id21">
<h2>Alternatives considered</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Pure Click: More verbose parameter definitions, no type annotation inference.</p></li>
<li><p>Argparse: Standard library but lacks subcommand ergonomics and type inference.</p></li>
<li><p>Docopt: Declarative but harder to compose nested subcommands.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="task-bundle-directory-layout">
<h2>Task bundle directory layout</h2>
<p><strong>Document version:</strong> 5</p>
</section>
<section id="id22">
<h2>Context</h2>
<p>Need a storage layout that scales to many sidecar collections per task (plans, runs, locks, todos, questions, changes, checks, handoffs, links, code reviews) while keeping each record individually addressable. Events are stored at ledger level, not per-task, and are enabled by default.</p>
</section>
<section id="id23">
<h2>Decision</h2>
<p>Use a directory-per-task layout (v2 bundle) under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code>. Each task gets a directory containing the task record (Markdown) and subdirectories for sidecar collections. JSON indexes, including the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary, are derived caches at the ledger level. Event records are stored in the ledger-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">events/</span></code> directory (not per-task) and are written by default; set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[event_logging]</span> <span class="pre">enabled</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">false</span></code> to disable. The current storage layout version is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TASKLEDGER_STORAGE_LAYOUT_VERSION</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">3</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="id24">
<h2>Consequences</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Positive: Each record is a single file - easy to read, edit, and version-control.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: Sidecar collections are independently addressable.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: The sidecar summary index keeps common read paths fast.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Many small files create directory overhead on very large projects.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id25">
<h2>Alternatives considered</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Single JSON index file: Merge conflicts, scalability, not human-readable.</p></li>
<li><p>Database (SQLite): Opaque, harder to inspect and version-control.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="external-skill-packaging">
<h2>External skill packaging</h2>
<p><strong>Document version:</strong> 5</p>
</section>
<section id="id26">
<h2>Context</h2>
<p>Agent skill files (SKILL.md) provide integration instructions for coding agents. Need to decide where they live relative to the Python package.</p>
</section>
<section id="id27">
<h2>Decision</h2>
<p>Skills live under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">skills/taskledger/</span></code> in the repository, outside the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span></code> Python package. They are not packaged as Python package data, not loaded via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">importlib.resources</span></code>, and not distributed via PyPI as part of the package.</p>
</section>
<section id="id28">
<h2>Consequences</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Positive: Clean separation between tool functionality and agent integration instructions.</p></li>
<li><p>Positive: Skills can be versioned independently and distributed through different channels.</p></li>
<li><p>Negative: Skill installation is a separate step from package installation.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id29">
<h2>Alternatives considered</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Package skills as package data: Coupling skill version to package version, harder to update independently.</p></li>
<li><p>Load skills via importlib.resources: Adds packaging complexity and coupling.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
<section id="quality-requirements">
<h1>Quality Requirements</h1>
<p>Quality requirements that gate architectural decisions:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Data integrity</strong>: Atomic writes and strict front matter validation prevent corrupt state. Partial writes are impossible due to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">os.replace</span></code> semantics.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>CLI exit code contract</strong>: Exit codes are stable and tested. Agents and CI pipelines rely on specific codes for automation.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>JSON envelope stability</strong>: The JSON output shape (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ok</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">command</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_type</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result</span></code>) is a public API contract. Breaking changes require explicit versioning.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Lifecycle gate correctness</strong>: Every stage transition is validated by policy functions with full test coverage of error paths.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Export/import round-trip</strong>: Archives preserve all state. Import into a fresh workspace reproduces the original taskledger state exactly.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Editable plan input preflight</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> returns a structured payload with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">passed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">summary</span></code>, indexed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issues</span></code>, and parsed counts. Lint and review are gate layers; preflight catches them earlier.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Implementation snapshot fidelity</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> blocks when the current workspace diverges from the implementation snapshot. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code> is the only sanctioned recovery path and records an audit trail.</p></li>
</ul>

<section id="quality-scenarios">
<h2>Quality Scenarios</h2>
<!-- archledger: no accepted records for this section yet -->

<section id="risks-and-technical-debt">
<h1>Risks and Technical Debt</h1>
<p>Known risks and areas of technical debt:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Storage scaling with many tasks</strong>: Each task is a directory with multiple sidecar files. Very large projects (hundreds of tasks) may see slowdowns in list and query operations because the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index is rebuilt from file scans on miss and updated on writes. The per-task sidecar index keeps the common read path fast but does not eliminate directory overhead.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Migration surface between storage versions</strong>: The storage layout is currently v3 (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TASKLEDGER_STORAGE_LAYOUT_VERSION</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/states.py</span></code>). Migration code in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/migrations.py</span></code> adds complexity. Future format changes must maintain backward compatibility or ship migration steps.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Service boundary erosion</strong>: Some service modules (notably <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tasks.py</span></code> and a few focused modules) have grown large. The service layer has no formal interface contracts; boundaries are enforced by convention and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tests/test_service_boundaries.py</span></code> whitelist in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/service_boundary_whitelist.md</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Implementation snapshot drift</strong>: Workspace snapshots are a strong invariant but require explicit refresh after environment changes. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">next-action</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> surface mismatch diagnostics; the recovery path is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Editable plan input compatibility</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">description</span></code> is accepted as an alias for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code> on acceptance criteria; strict mode promotes unknown-field findings to errors to prevent silent structured-data loss.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Growing dependency surface</strong>: The runtime dependency set is small (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typer</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">click</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PyYAML</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tomli</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>) but new dependencies must be justified by core features rather than optional presentations.</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="risk-overview">
<h2>Risk Overview</h2>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Title</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Severity</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Probability</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Mitigation</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Notes</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Storage scaling with many tasks</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>Run reindex after bulk changes; consider task archival for completed work.</p></td>
<td><p>Each task is a directory with multiple sidecar files. Projects with hundreds of tasks may see slowdowns in list and query operations due to file system scanning. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_sidecars.json</span></code> summary index is updated in place by per-task sidecar writes and is rebuilt on miss, which keeps the common read path fast. Mitigation: run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">reindex</span></code> after bulk changes; consider task archival for completed work; rely on the sidecar summary index for navigation.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Migration surface between storage versions</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>Doctor checks detect version mismatches; migration checks flag incompatible records.</p></td>
<td><p>The storage layout is currently v3 (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TASKLEDGER_STORAGE_LAYOUT_VERSION</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/domain/states.py</span></code>). Migration code in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/storage/migrations.py</span></code> adds complexity. Future format changes must maintain backward compatibility or provide migration steps. Mitigation: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span></code> checks detect version mismatches; migration checks in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor_checks/migration_checks.py</span></code> flag incompatible records.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Service boundary erosion</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>test_service_boundaries.py whitelist tracks allowed cross-module imports and fails on violations.</p></td>
<td><p>Some service modules (notably <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/tasks.py</span></code>) have grown large. The current long-function whitelist includes entries such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/cli_sync.py::register_sync_commands</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger/services/doctor_checks/task_checks.py::scan_task_integrity</span></code>. The service layer has no formal interface contracts; boundaries are enforced by convention and the whitelist in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/service_boundary_whitelist.md</span></code> exercised by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tests/test_service_boundaries.py</span></code>.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Growing dependency count</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>medium</p></td>
<td><p>Small dependency set (typer, PyYAML, tomli); each justified by a core feature.</p></td>
<td><p>The runtime dependency set is small (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typer</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">click</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PyYAML</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tomli</span></code> on Python &lt;3.11, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> for atomic I/O, JSON I/O, YAML I/O, front matter parsing, and cross-ledger ref parsing). Each dependency is justified by a core feature. Risk is low as long as new dependencies are not introduced without explicit justification, and as long as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> remains the boundary for low-level primitives.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</section>
<section id="glossary">
<h1>Glossary</h1>
<p>Domain terms used throughout taskledger. The full glossary lives in the per-term <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">glossary-NNNN</span></code> records under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/archledger/data/records/glossary/</span></code>. Each term is stored as a record with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">term</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">definition</span></code>, and reference metadata rather than in this section body.</p>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Term</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Definition</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Task</p></td>
<td><p>The primary unit of work with a managed lifecycle through planning, implementation, and validation stages.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Plan</p></td>
<td><p>A proposed implementation plan with acceptance criteria that gates implementation start.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Run</p></td>
<td><p>A record of an active work session (planning, implementation, or validation) paired with a lock.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Lock</p></td>
<td><p>A concurrency control mechanism preventing simultaneous actors on the same task stage.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Handoff</p></td>
<td><p>A context transfer record enabling a different actor to continue work from where the previous actor left off.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Todo</p></td>
<td><p>A concrete implementation step materialized from the accepted plan; gates implementation completion.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Acceptance Criterion</p></td>
<td><p>A testable condition that gates task completion during validation.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Actor</p></td>
<td><p>The entity performing an action, classified as agent, user, or system.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Harness</p></td>
<td><p>The execution environment running taskledger (agent harness, manual terminal, or CI).</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Stage</p></td>
<td><p>A position in the task lifecycle state machine (draft, planning, plan_review, approved, etc.).</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Sidecar</p></td>
<td><p>A collection of related records (todos, links, plans, etc.) attached to a task.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Front Matter</p></td>
<td><p>The YAML metadata block at the top of a canonical record file, delimited by —.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Worker Pipeline</p></td>
<td><p>An optional advisory overlay that guides fresh-context handoffs through sequential worker steps.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
